title: Research: exclude a P112 profile by three-endpoint A2 shortening
body:
## Summary

Add `research/p112-a2-singleton-shortening/`, a scoped characteristic-zero shortening proof and one historical TWOSIDE profile exclusion.

```text
2^3,5,6^3,7^4 in historical TWOSIDE (6,5)
  delete four unrestricted pieces
  retain two code dimensions and three rank-six endpoints
  A2 singleton capacity16 gives required support68 > allowance60
```

The general three-endpoint lemma permits common small support 21 and arbitrary nonmodal shifts. Its bound is 62>60. No sharp threshold, full C5, decoder-floor theorem, supplier or new kappa is claimed.

## Evidence

- Before: the pinned PR3154 filter accepts the profile among 174 historical survivors, with excess 35<36.
- After: registered CPython 3.12.15 replay and all 13 behavioral groups pass. A separate generated-span checker agrees on all 27 maximizing singleton intersections per class across 888,030 six-label subsets. Original caller labels are bound through an invertible nine-bit map.
- All 20 committed package/input byte comparisons pass. Both checkers and all 13 controls pass from the exact final committed read-only, Git-free export under optimized CPython 3.13.5. The export caught a private-fixture permissions issue, fixed on this branch without changing scientific sources or the receipt.
- [Hosted planning and registered replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39062559159) settled SUCCESS on exact head `2977a895c35fa019f53f181edee45177c77ec436`. Hosted logs contain both checker PASS markers and all 13 passing tests.
- `PROOF.md`, `RESULT.json`, `SOURCES.json` and `CHECKS.json` retain the argument, exact source pins, environments, outputs and unrun obligations. The selected cold replay is unrun because selected inputs are unchanged.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -I -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/p112-a2-singleton-shortening
```

Credit DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 at `708f0ad8928c383de8294aea3c126e9461d2066d`, Nick Petalas/PR3211 and the A3/A4/A5 predecessors, and the retained E8/P112 decoder lineage. The standard Weyl-chamber theorem and complete decoder reduction remain written dependencies. Substantial automated assistance was used; no independent human or proof-kernel review is claimed.

Canonical investigation: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19003040. Open next questions are in the package.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

Only a new research package is added. Frozen sources and the selected frontier are unchanged. Archival intake is not scientific admission.
